evidence: The hafnium–zirconium–oxide ﬁlm deposition was performed at 300°C. The process pressure was maintained at 0.5 Torr. Zirconium tetrachloride /H20849ZrCl4, kept at 150°C and carried by N2/H20850and hafnium tetrachloride /H20849HfCl4, kept at 150°C and carried by N2/H20850were used as the metal precursors, and H2O was used as the oxidizing agent. The N 2 purge gas was introduced for the complete separation of the source and the reactant gases.
